code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (pH 7.0, low O2 saturation/PaO2), anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with monocytosis and lymphopenia, elevated CRP and ferritin, and impaired renal function (high creatinine). INR is markedly elevated. Findings suggest severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or multi-organ dysfunction, and high risk of bleeding. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
